Lizzie Pannill Fletcher

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 7, Harris County, Texas · Incumbent

U.S. Representative for Texas' 7th Congressional District (since 2019); lawyer

Lizzie Pannill Fletcher is a Houston lawyer who has represented Texas' 7th Congressional District as a Democrat since January 2019. She was first elected in 2018 and is now in her fourth term. She was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where Fletcher stands

Social Security and Medicare
In her 2018 campaign platform, said she would oppose privatizing Social Security and Medicare or cutting benefits for seniors and people with disabilities, and would instead cut waste, fraud and abuse.
Health care and prescription drug costs
Says she is working to lower prescription drug prices and to advance health policies that reduce costs, increase consumer choices and expand coverage.

Background

  • U.S. Representative, Texas' 7th Congressional District, 2019–present (first elected 2018)
  • House Committee on Energy and Commerce; 2025–2026 subcommittees: Health, Oversight and Investigations, Energy
